nodes.question: What is the significance of implementing the material footprint to measure progress towards sustainable development goals 8 and 12?
nodes.answer: Implementing the material footprint helps to track resource consumption and waste generation, providing valuable insights for achieving sustainable development goals 8 (decent work and economic growth) and 12 (responsible consumption and production).
